propositions: Link-sync tests exercise only one representative relation (blocks) repeatedly, leaving depends_on and other relations untested, creating semantic blind spots.
Bug c8ed (outbound depends_on direction swap) shipped because the relation vocabulary was not parametrized in test coverage.

The outbound _diff_links emission must be parametrized over all 6 relations with assertions on both mapped (blocks, depends_on, relates_to) and unmapped (duplicates, supersedes, discovered_from) relations.
A REMOVE case is missing coverage for outward Blocks links whose local depends_on dependency was removed, specifically the untested inward/outward direction logic branch at outbound_links.py:193-202.
Test assertions must verify exact orientation (type, swap tuple) per relation, not merely presence, to catch regressions in direction-swap logic.
